newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austria's ATX ends at record high for fourth day.
newsitem.headline: Austria's ATX ends at record high for fourth day.

text.p: Austria's ATX index of 21 blue chips ended at a record high for the fourth session on Thursday, adding on 16.65 points, or 1.22 percent, to 1,381.4.
But traders said the peak may have been reached as trading volume was below Wednesday's levels.
Traders traced today's gains above all to engineering group VA Tech, which rose 5.36 percent to 2,520 schillings on turnover of nearly 47,000 lots.
* Winners outpace losers, with 13 ATX shares higher and eight lower.
* Top ATX gainer beverage group BBAG, up 6.88 percent to 823.
* Leading ATX decliner fibre producer Lenzing, down 1.51 percent at 717.
* July ATX future up 18.6 points at 1,389.1 with 831 contracts traded.
